title: A hard disk, opened
alt: A laptop hard disk with its cover off: one shiny round platter fills most of the case, and the reading arm is parked at the edge, beside it.
author: Evan-Amos
description: A 2.5" hard drive that has been opened, exposing its inner workings. This is a 500GB Western Digital Scorpio Blue hard drive with SATA connections. This 2.5" hard drive is common in laptops.
